'''Grilled crupa breast''' was a [[Foodstuff/Legends|food]] dish, made from the [[crupa]] [[Bird/Legends|bird]]. The catering company [[Estimable Epicures]] served garnished plates of grilled crupa breast at a reception hosted by the [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lords]] [[Ritinki]] and [[Vop]] aboard the [[Ithorian Herdship|Ithorian herdship]] ''[[Song of the Clouds]]''.<ref name="J15">{{JournalCite|15|The Great Herdship Heist}}</ref>
